title: Breakdown of all 7 private Moon landing attempts, 2019-2025

source.name: Compiled mission outcome record (Beresheet, Hakuto-R M1/M2, Peregrine Mission One, IM-1 Odysseus, IM-2 Athena, Blue Ghost Mission 1)
source.publisher: NASA CLPS program / company mission reports

notes: 4 of 7 attempts crashed or never reached the surface (Beresheet, Hakuto-R M1, Peregrine, Resilience). 2 landed but tipped onto their side (Odysseus, Athena). 1 landed clean (Blue Ghost).
